(405)༄༅/ /snying po rdo rje'i tshig ces bya ba lce rtse rkan sbyar gyi gdams ngag gi rtsa ba

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (405)༄༅// snying po rdo rje'i tshig ces bya ba lce rtse rkan sbyar gyi gdams ngag gi rtsa ba

bzhugs so// (406)༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ hṝ da ya badzra pa da nā ma/ bod skad du/ snying po rdo rje'i tshig ces bya ba// rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// grub chen sha ba ris ma hā paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen la gsungs pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'di la gnyis/ dngos grub kyi nye rgyu'i gnas la gsang bar gdams pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub chen po sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ gang yar theg pa dman gnas dang*// mi gang rtog ge la dga' dang*// gang zhig dge slong dngos gnas dang*// de la de nyid bstan mi bya// gnyis pa la gsum/ mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor/ mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor/ chags can gyi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gnyis/ rang bzhin mngon du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa dang*/ de brten nas rang gi 'dod pa'i lha spro ba'o// dang po ni/ lce rtse rkan sbyar rnal 'byor la// gcig tu brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gnyis pa ni// mkha' dang dngos phyogs thams cad la// lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i 'gyur la/ gang yang theg pa sogs shtso ka gcig dang*/ 'di'i mkha' dang sogs tshig rkang gnyis med/ mchan/ sangs rgyas nyid ni rtag tu spro// dum bu ma yin dkyil 'khor gyi// rnam pa gang gis brtan g.yo khyab// gang gis go 'phang de ston pa'i// dpal ldan bla ma de la 'dud/ gnyis pa mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor ni// rdo rje nyi ma'ang gang sems ni// nor bu'i nang du son par blta// ye shes dkyil 'khor rnam pa yis// khams gsum po ni snang bar bya// gsum pa chags can gyi rnal (407)'byor la gsum/ dbang rnon phyag rgya chen mo dang sbyor ba/ thod rgal ba phyag rgya bzhi ka dang sbyor ba/ dman pa las rgya dang sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ phyag rgya gcig la mnyam sbyor dang*// gnyis pa ni/ yang na phyag rgya bzhi sbyor ba/

gsum pa ni/ btsun mo'i grong du 'jug gyur kyang*// sgyu ma'i sku ni rjes dran bya// snying po rdo rje'i tshig ri khrod zhabs kyis paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen la gnang*/ des rgyal ba'i dbang po kun dga' dpal 'byor la gnang ba'o// maṅga laṃ//
